item.title: Uber Caps Claude Code Sessions at 400K Tokens to Curb AI Costs
item.description:
After exhausting its AI budget, Uber caps engineers' Claude Code sessions at 400K tokens even on million-token models. Weekly agent requests grew 9.4x from February to August and weekly active users of its AI coding tools grew 7x, yet overall AI spending has stayed roughly flat since April, with cost per session down 52% from its June peak. Uber still runs MCP servers but routes agents through command-line tools tied to a central MCP gateway, avoiding the 50K-70K tokens needed to preload descriptions for 100-plus tools.

原文标题：Uber 将 Claude Code 会话压缩至 40 万 token

Why it matters：头部科技公司在大规模智能体落地中如何控制上下文与 token 成本的实战数据，对构建 Agent 系统的团队有直接参考价值。

item.description:

The effort emphasizes privacy and remains in early stages, with Apple reportedly eyeing a launch as soon as the end of next year.

原文标题：苹果招聘岗位透露正研发 Mac 端自主 AI 智能体

Why it matters：苹果入局设备级自主智能体，标志主流操作系统厂商正式押注 Agent 范式。

item.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Predicts AI Research Speedup Doubling Every Three Months
item.description:
Former Anthropic and OpenAI researcher Jacob Coxon said at Y Combinator's first debate that Anthropic staff self-report a 4-5x AI research speedup that roughly doubles every three months, extrapolating to 100x by 2027. He also predicted Claude will handle all of Anthropic's AI research by late 2027, with about 25% already running through it. These are personal extrapolations from self-reported figures without verifiable methodology.

Why it matters：涉及头部实验室内部 AI 研发自动化比例与提速趋势的一手转述，虽为个人预测但具行业风向标价值。

item.title: OpenAI Opens GPT-Live-1.1 API for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
item.description:
OpenAI has opened its GPT-Live-1.1 voice model API to third-party developers. Built on a full-duplex architecture, the model listens and speaks simultaneously while detecting pauses, interruptions, and pace changes. Its key advance is delegating deep reasoning and tool-calling tasks to a developer-chosen backend model without interrupting the live conversation, merging real-time voice interaction with multi-step agent workflows.

原文标题：OpenAI 开放 GPT-Live-1.1 API 支持全双工语音智能体

Why it matters：全双工语音加后端模型委托，是语音智能体从对话走向任务执行的关键架构升级。

item.title: OpenAI Deploys Multi-Agent System to Auto-Diagnose ChatGPT Outages
item.description:
OpenAI has built a multi-agent operations pipeline in which alerts about ChatGPT slowdowns automatically launch Codex agents that sift through logs and recent code changes to identify root causes. A second agent then attempts to disprove the diagnosis, and a third proposes a code fix for human engineer approval. The system runs roughly 17 investigations per day with about 70% judged accurate, but remediation remains the weak link: of 600-plus diagnosed problems, only about 15 agent-authored fixes shipped unchanged.

原文标题：OpenAI 部署多智能体自动排查 ChatGPT 故障

Why it matters：这是大厂首次公开多智能体对抗式运维闭环的真实量化数据，诊断强、修复弱的结论对智能体落地极具参考价值。

item.title: SageMaker Inference 2026 Update Adds Cross-Region Routing and GPU Sharing
item.description:
AWS reviewed its 2026 SageMaker Inference updates, including new routing strategies for HyperPod Inference, broader model-serving framework support and expanded multi-Region networking, with the Inference Gateway handling routing and managed NVIDIA Dynamo added as a new serving framework. For managed endpoints, inference recommendations now run from SageMaker AI Studio, the Python SDK and coding agents, and endpoints can route requests across Regions and accounts, helping teams re-select configurations after traffic shifts, pack more models onto paid-for GPUs and fix idle capacity across Regions.

原文标题：SageMaker 推理 2026 升级 支持跨区域路由与多模型共享 GPU

Why it matters：这是 AWS 推理基础设施的年度能力盘点，涉及跨区域路由、GPU 多模型共享与托管 Dynamo，对部署大模型服务的工程团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Lets Agents Rewrite Their Own Harness to Boost Task Success Eightfold
item.description:
Google researchers propose a self-improving harness architecture in which an optimizer model directly edits the agent's runtime framework code, keeping only changes that pass validation. On 40 SWE-bench Lite tasks, the modular approach lifted success from 5.0% to 40.0% at roughly 46.7K tokens per task, far below the 451.6K tokens needed for unconstrained full rewrites. The paper also flags risks of prompt bloat, benchmark overfitting and evaluator tampering.

原文标题：谷歌让智能体自改 Harness 任务成功率提升 8 倍

Why it matters：首次系统验证智能体可自改运行框架代码并获得 8 倍任务成功率提升，为 Agent 工程化提供新范式。

item.title: Google to Roll Out Global Android Developer Verification in 2027
item.description:

After fierce developer backlash following its August 2025 announcement, Google softened sideloading restrictions and added a risk-confirmation flow for advanced users installing apps from unverified developers.

item.title: AWS Lets AI Agents Buy Marketplace Products via AgentCore
item.description:

item.title: Overmind Launches Chat-Based Model Fine-Tuning via Grok on Mobile
item.description:
Overmind launched an MCP-based fine-tuning service that lets users upload labeled data and trigger training by chatting with Grok on a phone. Overmind's own GPUs fine-tune Qwen3.5-0.8B, then evaluate both the original and tuned models on held-out test rows and return scores to Grok. The workflow wraps dataset reading, training and evaluation as MCP tools, lowering the barrier to customizing small models.

原文标题：Overmind 推出手机端对话式微调小模型服务

item.title: Kong Launches Volcano Cloud Platform Built for AI Agents
item.description:
Kong has released Volcano, a cloud platform purpose-built for AI agents, bundling hosting, Postgres, authentication, storage, sandboxes and long-running workflows so agents built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can be deployed directly. Its centerpiece LavaFlow monitors the live app and codebase, diagnoses failures and submits fixes via GitHub, enabling self-healing operations. The platform targets agent workloads that run for hours, wait on humans or fail midway, which conventional request-oriented hosting handles poorly.

原文标题：Kong 推出 Volcano 智能体云平台

Why it matters：Kong 将智能体长时运行与自愈修复能力打包为云基础设施，代表托管范式从请求级向智能体级的迁移。

The central tension is balancing teams' freedom to innovate quickly against enterprise-wide standards for safety, security, composability and cost efficiency, lest the organization fragment into AI islands.
